title: hieracium olivaceum subsp. lividulum
intro: Hieracium olivaceum subsp. lividulum, commonly known as the mouse-ear hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion-like genus Hieracium. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, acting as an antiseptic, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium olivaceum subsp. lividulum include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and show antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
